text:
maria: Heads-up: vendor invoice INV-2026-0998 (Lusa Devs Lda) includes 23% VAT but the PO indicates our EU VAT ID and vendor marked supply as B2B. Holding payment for clarification.

leo: @sophie can tax confirm if we should ask for a corrected invoice with reverse charge? Also vendor mentioned they are on a "regime simplificado" in Portugal.

sophie: Short answer: if vendor is a Portuguese legal entity and our VAT ID is valid, reverse charge can apply for cross-border B2B services. Need verification: 1) VIES validation of vendor VAT, 2) reissued invoice showing our VAT and wording like "IVA - autoliquidação / reverse charge", 3) vendor confirmation that invoicing entity is the same legal entity on the invoice.

taxbot: Parsed invoice INV-2026-0998 | amount EUR 4,620.00 | VAT EUR 846.60 | vendor VAT: PT123456780 | received_ts: 2398765400

maria: Vendor's reply: "We are registered as regime simplificado (NIF PT123456780). We charged VAT because our accountant advised so. We can reissue if required." Attached invoice PDF.

sophie: Run VIES 7: PT123456780 validated as active (screenshot uploaded). Request reissue with explicit reverse charge line. If they assert simplified regime prevents reverse charge, ask them to cite legal basis. Typically simplificado affects domestic VAT thresholds, not the mechanic of reverse charge for cross-border B2B.

leo: Also vendor included a second request asking for our US tax docs (W-9) because their parent in US wants to complete reconciliation. We should clarify: W-9 only if the invoicing entity is a US person. If the invoice entity has PT VAT and is Portuguese, do not ask for W-9. Ask vendor to confirm legal entity and tax residency.

sophie: Draft to send: "Please confirm legal entity name and tax residency for the entity issuing the invoice. If the invoicing entity is Portuguese (PT123456780), please reissue without VAT and include 'IVA - autoliquidação / reverse charge' plus our EU VAT ID EU987654321. If the invoicing entity is a US entity, provide W-9 and confirm that the invoice will be reissued by that entity."

maria: Sent at 10:07. Vendor replied within the hour saying they'll reissue with reverse charge. :smile:

leo: Finance, keep payment on hold for VAT amount until corrected invoice arrives. If vendor reissues correctly, release payment for net amount. If they insist on charging VAT, escalate and request credit note.

sophie: I'll verify the reissued file once uploaded and do the final sign-off. If they reissue with wrong entity or add US W-9 without proof, we'll escalate to legal/tax.

maria: Will upload vendor PDF when received and ping @sophie. Closing loop here until then.
